items.note: Quasi-experiment in which college students solved a mathematical creativity task with or without ChatGPT; mathematical creativity of the solutions was higher with ChatGPT; N not in abstract; check overlap with the Liu (2025) mathematical-creativity study.

Pretest-posttest quasi-experiment with 215 preservice teachers (generative-AI versus traditional teaching-skills training) whose outcomes are teacher self-efficacy and a higher-order-thinking score, not a creative output; cited by a creativity meta-analysis, so the full text could confirm whether higher-order thinking includes a creativity subscale (likely a questionnaire).

CHI 2026 controlled study (N=50) comparing stories co-written with the multi-persona NarrativeLoom system against a comparison condition, with experts rating Torrance creativity dimensions; the comparison condition and assignment are not described in the abstract; arXiv 2603.07155 is the same work.

Randomized three-arm study of 480 Vietnamese undergraduates (no AI, unconstrained GenAI, structured prompt scaffolding) on concept-generation and essay-design tasks, scored by expert CAT, TTCT metrics, and semantic distance; unconstrained AI lowered originality (d = -0.58); obscure conference proceedings, verify the full text.

Between-subjects experiment with 221 employees varying proximal human-AI collaboration (high versus low); outcomes are idea selection and idea implementation behaviors, with idea originality only as a moderator, so no creativity score on produced output.

Seven online and lab experiments (n = 10,462 in total; largest single experiment not in abstract) assigning people to learn a topic from LLM syntheses versus web search links and then write advice, which was sparser and less original; AI is not used while writing the advice, so possibly after_ai; the search notes report across-writer similarity measures in the full text.

Paper combining a longitudinal survey with a randomized experiment comparing supportive versus AI-substitutive generative-AI interaction modes during a creative thinking task; supportive interaction improved originality and semantic distance; experiment N not in abstract.

Quasi-experiment in a university workshop (16 participants, four teams, 12 startup ideas) comparing human-only ideation, unstructured AI, a structured prompting framework, and the framework with separated AI roles, with idea quality rated by instructor, peers, and AI; far below 50 participants.

AEA RCT Registry entry only (no paper or results): matchstick-figure task with no assistance versus optional generative-AI assistance (preselected or free prompts), panel-rated originality and elaboration; session-level random scheduling; planned 50-70 adults and 50-70 children per arm; the next stage should check whether results exist.

Quasi-experimental cohort comparison in a graduate course (2023 without, 2024 with the GPT-based JeepyTA assistant) of students' ideation on educational uses of a video game, measuring idea counts, quality, and homogeneity; N not in abstract; EdArXiv preprint 10.35542/osf.io/yuagx_v1 is the same work.
